description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that develops quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. The Software Engineer - Marketing Systems & Integrations supports and enhances marketing automation and CRM platforms through technical configuration, integration management, campaign automation, troubleshooting, and data governance.
Marketing automation systems integration engineer for CRM sync, platform administration, and campaign operations

Responsibilities:
• Support user account creation, access permissions, and role governance across marketing automation and CRM platforms to maintain secure, compliant operations
• Translate stakeholder requirements into technical configurations, reusable templates, and scalable operational solutions within a marketing automation platform (e.g., Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, or similar)
• Help maintain platform architecture — folder structures, naming conventions, tokens, and operational program frameworks
• Build and maintain field mappings and synchronization logic between the marketing platform and CRM (e.g., Salesforce), supporting schema alignment and data quality
• Clone, configure, and test forms, landing pages, and web assets in Sandbox and Production environments using HTML/CSS fundamentals
• Troubleshoot sync issues between systems, including field conflicts, validation errors, and API-related failures — with support from senior engineers as needed
• Assist with datatype changes, schema updates, and cross-system compatibility checks to keep integrations stable
• Support Sandbox refresh activities: configuration audits, asset restoration, and sync re-establishment
• Help build and maintain trigger-based campaigns, automated workflows, and nurture programs, learning platform-specific logic on the job
• Assist with segmentation setup, audience management, and basic data governance practices
• Monitor system health and campaign performance dashboards, flagging issues to senior team members
• Support data quality and compliance standards across marketing and CRM systems

Requirements:
• • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related technical field (or equivalent practical experience)
• • 1–2 years of experience in a technical, engineering, or systems support role
• • Working knowledge of HTML and CSS; exposure to basic JavaScript is a plus
• • Understanding of how APIs and webhooks work, or strong aptitude to learn integration concepts quickly
• • Interest in or exposure to CRM systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.) and/or marketing automation platforms — prior hands-on Marketo experience is not required
• • Comfort working with structured data: field mapping, data types, and schema logic
• • Strong problem-solving instincts and willingness to troubleshoot systematically
• • Clear communicator, able to explain technical issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

Preferred:
• • Any exposure to Marketo, HubSpot, Pardot, or similar marketing automation tools
• • Familiarity with CRM objects (Leads/Contacts/Accounts/Opportunities)
• • Coursework or personal projects involving REST APIs or third-party integrations (e.g., ad platforms like Google, Meta, or LinkedIn)
• • Certifications are a plus but not expected at this level (e.g., Marketo Certified Associate/Expert, Salesforce Admin)
